{{ety|en|:af|school|child|text=+|tree=1}}

* {{enPR|skōōlchīld}}, {{IPA|en|/ˈskuːlt͡ʃaɪld/}}, {{IPA|en|/ˈsku.əlt͡ʃaɪld/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-schoolchild.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{hyphenation|en|school|child}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|schoolchildren}}

# A [[young]] [[person]] attending school or of an age to attend [[school]].
#: {{syn|en|pupil|student<q:especially US>|schoolkid<q:informal>}}
#: {{hypo|en|schoolboy|schoolgirl}}
#* {{RQ:Marshall Squire's Daughter|A Court Ball|9|They stayed together during three dances, went out on to the terrace, explored wherever they were permitted to explore, paid two visits to the buffet, and enjoyed themselves much in the same way as if they had been '''school-children''' surreptitiously breaking loose from an assembly of grown-ups.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=1988 January 29|author=Steve Bogira|title=Interdistrict Transfer|journal=Chicago Reader|url=https://securesite.chireader.com/cgi-bin/Archive/abridged2.bat?path=1988/880129/INTERDIS
|passage={{...|After a federal district court ordered school desegregation in Milwaukee in 1976,}} the Wisconsin legislature passed a law providing incentives for transfers of '''schoolchildren''' in the metropolitan area, both intradistrict and interdistrict.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2011|author=Meg Mitchell Moore|title=The Arrivals|passage=Spring ahead, fall back: Kathleen had once learned some rhyme about that when she was a '''schoolchild''', but she no longer remembered it.}}
